Issue Name: Chronic Merchant Dispatch SLA Breaches (>4 Days)
Root Cause: Unmonitored third-party merchants taking 4+ days to pack and hand parcels to carriers.
Recommended Operational Action: Enforce strict 48-hour fulfillment SLA with merchant penalties and search ranking de-boosting.
Target KPI Uplift: Lift chronic seller cohort OTD rate from 78.4% to >90.0%; prevent ~1,200 late deliveries annually.

Issue Name: Rio de Janeiro (RJ) Interstate Transit Congestion
Root Cause: Last-mile courier fragmentation and carrier depot backlogs in metropolitan Rio de Janeiro.
Recommended Operational Action: Contract secondary local carrier; establish regional distribution buffer hub in RJ.
Target KPI Uplift: Reduce RJ delay rate from 13.3% to <7.5%; improve RJ mean rating from 3.88 to 4.15.

Issue Name: Weekend Warehouse Packaging & Dispatch Depot Freeze
Root Cause: Warehouses operate on reduced weekend staffing; carriers do not pick up between Friday 5 PM and Monday 9 AM.
Recommended Operational Action: Introduce Friday 2:00 PM packaging cutoff and negotiate Saturday morning carrier sweep collections.
Target KPI Uplift: Reduce weekend order processing time from 3.73 days to <2.5 days; save ~1.2 days across 25k orders.

Issue Name: Northeast Long-Haul Interstate Corridor Bottleneck (Bahia / BA)
Root Cause: Excessive transit distance (>1,500 km) from Southeast sellers with intermediate sorting hub delays.
Recommended Operational Action: Route consolidation and line-haul direct injection to Salvador sorting center.
Target KPI Uplift: Reduce Bahia median transit time from 18.9 days to <14 days; improve OTD from 84.2% to >90%.

Issue Name: Bulky Freight & Heavy Category Promised Date Underestimation
Root Cause: Estimated delivery algorithms apply standard parcel transit times to heavy, non-standard freight.
Recommended Operational Action: Implement dynamic delivery promise buffering (+3 to +5 business days) for bulky freight.
Target KPI Uplift: Increase bulky category OTD rate from 81.3% to >93.5%; reduce 1-star reviews in furniture by 40%.
